provenance.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE), state and county
provenance.notes: Values are the Census Bureau's published SAIPE county estimates read from the fixed-width state-and-county release; this repo performs no modelling and no rescaling. SAIPE is a model-based program, so each value ships with the Bureau's own 90% confidence bounds. No API key is used or required. A suppressed or unpublished cell becomes null, never zero.
